facts: Deed from Thomas Wend to his son Aaron Wend, residential parcel, gift. Aaron lives in the home year round but lists a spare bedroom on a short-term rental site, renting it for a total of 9 days during the calendar year. No other business use.

expected.notes: TRAP — subsection precision. 27a(11)(c) defines 'commercial purpose' to EXCLUDE rental of residential real property for fewer than 15 days in a calendar year. 9 days does not defeat the (u) exception. A model that sees 'rental' and reflexively uncaps fails this.
